after: every decision, critic and adjudication of the round, and the first run of compare.py; this amendment is a defect fix made with the results known, disclosed as such
defect: compare.py's row_picks() treated a row with installs_nothing_extra=true as a NONE pick. That flag also marks picks that run on GitHub rather than on the host: the manifest's build-provenance row (actions/attest, definitive, outcome final) and dependency-updates row (Dependabot, resolved, installed on a critic's verdict). Amendment 2's rule text says 'agree when the pick is the row's repository, or NONE on a row that installs nothing'; both rows name their repository, so the code contradicted the frozen text.
fix: a row's pick is the repository it names; NONE only when it names none (a new test covers a named repository with installs_nothing_extra=true)

effect.unchanged: the decision rule, every judgment, selection.json and every other verdict; compare.py reads selection.json and the pinned manifest only
